title: The Radio That Worked Only at Dusk
central_conflict: the hilltop radio failed each afternoon before returning at dusk
decisive_choice: a rotating metal wind vane blocked the antenna at certain angles
resolution: relocated the antenna and verified reception through the afternoon
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the hilltop radio failed each afternoon before returning at dusk before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they changed its battery but reception stayed poor; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a rotating metal wind vane blocked the antenna at certain angles; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they relocated the antenna and verified reception through the afternoon, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Vanishing Platform Number

title: The Dry Cave With Wet Footprints
central_conflict: wet footprints appeared in a cave that had no visible stream
decisive_choice: condensation from a cold overhead fissure dripped onto a narrow ledge
resolution: marked the slippery ledge and redirected visitors along a safe path
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered wet footprints appeared in a cave that had no visible stream before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they searched the entrance for rainwater but the ground was dry; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized condensation from a cold overhead fissure dripped onto a narrow ledge; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they marked the slippery ledge and redirected visitors along a safe path, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
